title: Waiting on you (A): settled-ruling guard — refuse a second answer or dismiss with 409 ruling-settled
description:
Session **A** of LIN-4144 (Home's Waiting on you live refresh). This is plan piece 1. LIN-4142 is folded in here. It lands first, in its own PR, and B and C build on it.

## This piece's slice of the approved plan

**Behaviour:** answering or dismissing a ruling that is already settled is refused with `409 { code: 'ruling-settled', error: 'This ruling was already answered or dismissed.' }`. The refusal writes no comment and starts no run.

**Files and approach:**

* `lib/dispatch-store.js`: `markDecisionAnswered` (≈3780) becomes check-and-stamp on `feedbackVersion`, using the same CAS as `markDecisionWithdrawalReversed` (≈3914). When the decision is already stamped (answer or dismissal), it returns `{ success: false, alreadySettled: true }` instead of pushing a second stamp.
* **Callers must honour the CAS result** (review note 2). `dismissSpec` (`routes/dashboard-rulings.js`, `if (!stamped)`) and `stampDecisionAnswers` (`(await …) ? null : msg`) both treat the object as truthy today. Make both turn `alreadySettled` into the 409. For an answer that loses the race, the comment is already written, but no run may start.
* **Pre-check** in the comment route (`routes/workspace-api-issue-write.js`). Place it *after* the LIN-2208 dedupe-hit branch (≈504-527) and immediately before `writeComment` (review note 3). Refuse only if the **primary** `decisionLoopId` is already stamped. A copy that is already stamped (a partial earlier attempt) must not refuse, and counts as landed.
* The same pre-check goes in `dismissSpec` (`routes/dashboard-rulings.js`, ≈218), so a stale dismiss never sends the "proceed on your best judgment" run.
* **Scan (task-bound) rows:** keep `firstStampWins`. `POST /api/scan/:issueId/dismiss` (`routes/workspace-api-scan.js` ≈370) and the scan answer path return 409 `ruling-settled` when the existing outcome is `answered`/`dismissed`. `self-resolved` stays answerable, because `answer()` deliberately un-retires it (review note 4). Use the store's existing outcome read, and add one only if none exists.
* **Client** (`public/question-cards.js` `sendReply`/`dismissQuestionCard`): a `ruling-settled` refusal is not a generic failure. Announce "Answered elsewhere" through the existing `RULING_GONE_EVENT` and remove the card. `errorFromResult` (`public/common.js` ≈1039) already carries `code`.

**Testing (witnesses 1–2):**

* Answer the same loop ruling twice. The second call returns 409 `ruling-settled`, writes no comment, enqueues no run and adds no stamp.
* Two concurrent answers produce exactly **one stamp and one run**, not just one stamp.
* A dismiss after an answer returns 409 and starts no run. The same holds for a scan row.
* A first answer to a joined-lineage or shelved row stamps every copy and succeeds. An identical-text retry (primary landed, copy failed) stamps the copy and is not refused.
* Client unit: a 409 `ruling-settled` removes the card with "Answered elsewhere".

**Out of scope:** withdrawn rulings (`decision-withdrawn`) are not "settled" under this guard (review note 11). Say so in the PR so nobody assumes they are covered.

**On merge:** close LIN-4142 with a pointer to this PR.

**Session fit: fits one session.** The work is a server and store guard plus a small client branch, and the plan made it its own PR.

**Grounding commit:** LinearViewer `main` at `476d9ad478ede67da5cb44195ce24c98d07afa61` (the plan and its review were both written against it; re-checked unchanged at breakdown, 4 Nov 22:40Z).

**Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4144's approving plan-review (comment** `7ad6c803-0434-496e-b1aa-0a9d7d36f0ab`**, rev 1).**

**Starting point:** LIN-4144's approved plan is where this piece starts. Read it in full in LIN-4144's description (`## Implementation Plan`), and read the review's 11 builder notes in comment `7ad6c803`. Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4144.

## Landed

Implemented as approved on LIN-4144 (no deviations from the plan's places; two review-driven additions: a per-key primary-landed marker and a client `answerAttemptId`). PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279>), merged as `94195271`. Scope above kept as the single source of truth; no separate plan or research sections were embedded in this description, so nothing was pruned. Full history is in the task snapshots and the comment trail. Follow-ups: LIN-4244, LIN-4245.

comments.body:
PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279 (branch feat/lin-4241-settled-ruling-guard, commit 767bc453)

Settled-ruling guard implemented: answering or dismissing an already answered/dismissed ruling returns 409 { code: 'ruling-settled' }, writes no comment, adds no stamp and starts no run. Store CAS (markDecisionAnswered), comment-route and dismiss pre-checks, scan-row handling, and client "Answered elsewhere" card removal.

Evidence:
- Unit suite: 23114 pass, 0 fail. Hermetic keyed: 23114 pass.
- Witnesses fail on the unfixed code and pass after; generic-500 controls pass both ways.
- Playwright (rulings, waiting block, scan, session page, home desk/folds): 91 pass (subset).
- CI on PR #2279: Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success all SUCCESS.

Follow-ups: Rulings tab (observation.js) still shows generic copy on 409 (no run starts). Withdrawn rulings are not covered by this guard. LIN-4142 to close with a pointer to this PR on merge.

## Review — LIN-4241

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279 at head `767bc453194d7bb362d1a6d4b6c2fe3fbda5468d` (base `main` 950113b1; the PR's merge-base is the grounding commit 476d9ad4, and the one commit since, LIN-4234, touches none of these files).

CI: green on 767bc453. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all SUCCESS (run 41929823455).

### Scope vs plan
The diff stays inside the plan's places: store CAS, the `isDecisionSettled` / `readOutcome` reads, comment-route and `dismissSpec` pre-checks, the scan dismiss and answer routes, and the `question-cards.js` branch. It adds one new helper (`lib/ruling-settled.js`, a single refusal shape). No overrun. Callers honour the CAS result (review note 2). In `dismissSpec`'s copy loop, an `alreadySettled` copy is truthy, so it counts as landed, which is correct. `answerSpec`'s old `ALREADY_TERMINAL` code has no client consumer (grep of `public/`), so the switch to `ruling-settled` is safe. Withdrawn rulings are not treated as settled, and the store test pins that.

### Finding (blocks): an identical-text retry is refused after its own primary stamp landed (plan witness 4 / review note 3)
`routes/workspace-api-issue-write.js`, dedupe-hit branch (`const settledElsewhere = !decisionStampDedupe.get(key) && await stampAnswers();`) together with `stampDecisionAnswers` (`loopId === d.decisionLoopId ? { landed: false, settledElsewhere: true }`).

Scenario: on the first attempt the primary stamp lands but a copy stamp fails. `everyStampLanded` is false, so the dedupe key is not set, and the route returns 201. On the identical-text retry, the real store's CAS reports the **primary** as `alreadySettled`, because this request stamped it itself. That becomes `settledElsewhere`, so the route returns **409 ruling-settled**. The copy does get stamped, but the plan says this retry "stamps the copy and **is not refused**." I reproduced it with a stateful store in a temporary probe test (reverted): first=201, retry=409 `ruling-settled`, stamps=[loop-1, copy-1, loop-1, copy-1].

Why it matters: the client removes the card as "Answered elsewhere", which is false. If the first 201 never reached the client (a dropped response is exactly what makes someone resubmit), no run is ever started for a recorded answer. The in-code comment ("or its own earlier primary stamp … answers 409") shows the deviation was deliberate, but nobody raised it on LIN-4144 as the ticket asks. The existing LIN-2208 test cannot catch it, because its fake `markDecisionAnswered` is stateless.

Fix (implementation):
1. Remember, per dedupe `key`, that **this key's** primary stamp landed. For example, `stampAnswers` records `primaryLanded` alongside `decisionStampDedupe`, or `stampDecisionAnswers` returns `primaryLanded` and the route caches it for the key.
2. In the dedupe-hit branch, treat a primary `alreadySettled` as landed, not settled, when this key's own primary landed earlier. Keep the 409 when it did not. That keeps the existing race-loser retry test: its primary never landed, so it is still refused.
3. Add the witness to `tests/unit/comment-write-route.test.js`, using the stateful `makeSettlingStore` style: primary lands, copy fails once, identical retry → 200 `deduped`, copy stamped, no further comment. Mutation-check it against the current code (it must go red there).

### Mutation checks (LIN-2274): all red, all reverted
M1 CAS settled-check removed → store test red (4). M2 `feedbackVersion` filter removed from the CAS → concurrent-answers store test red. M3 comment-route loop pre-check removed → red (3). M4 post-stamp 409 in `finishCommentSuccess` removed → concurrent route test red. M5 dedupe-hit 409 removed → red. M6 comment-route scan pre-check removed → red. M7 `dismissSpec` pre-check removed → red. M8 `dismissSpec` CAS-result 409 removed → red. M9 scan dismiss guard removed → red. M10/M11 client answer/dismiss branches removed → client test red. M12 primary-vs-copy distinction collapsed → red. The tests pin the right paths. The gap is the missing witness above, not weak tests.

### Regression check
`git log -30` on the 7 touched source files: no reverts. LIN-2208 (dedupe bypass for a failed stamp) still works for a primary-failed stamp, but see the finding for the copy-failed variant. LIN-3959 (joined copies) is intact. LIN-2889's `answer()` un-retire for `self-resolved` is untouched, and the scan answer/dismiss paths only refuse `answered`/`dismissed`. LIN-3009's `feedbackVersion` `$inc` is kept inside the CAS write.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
Class: client surfaces that answer or dismiss a ruling and now get a 409 `ruling-settled` they did not get before. Only `public/question-cards.js` handles it (the plan's bounded client place). Unhandled siblings, all **outside** this ticket's bounded classes (UX copy on surfaces the plan did not name; server behaviour is correct, with no comment and no run):
- `public/observation.js` Rulings tab: generic failure copy on 409 (the implementer noted this).
- `public/scan.js` `runDismiss`: a dismiss of a row already answered or dismissed used to get 200 and render the settled note. It now renders the error state with "This ruling was already answered or dismissed." The plan made the route change; the page's handling is new UX.
- `public/flight-companion.js` and `public/session.js` answers through `ReplyDelivery.postComment`: generic failure copy.
Close-out should file one follow-up for these, checking first that LIN-4242 (shared keyed card merge) does not already absorb them.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (plan witness 4 / review note 3, comment-route pre-check class): an identical-text retry after primary-landed / copy-failed is not refused. **Not met.** Settled by the fix above plus its witness test, before the merge. Distinguishing precondition: a stateful store where the primary stamp succeeds and a copy stamp returns null on the first call; the retry must return 200 `deduped`, not 409.
- **Inside** (store CAS class): the CAS is proven against `tests/fixtures/mock-collection.js`, not real MongoDB. Settle before the merge by running the store's concurrent-answers witness (8 parallel `markDecisionAnswered` on one decision) against a real Mongo, if the suite has a Mongo-backed arm. Otherwise, after the deploy, with a manual double-submit from two tabs on one loop ruling, checking that the item's feedback has exactly one `decision-answer` stamp for that `decision_id`.
- **Inside** (client card removal): no E2E drives a real browser through a 409 `ruling-settled` on a Home "Waiting on you" card (the client test uses a DOM stub). Settle before the merge with a manual repro: open the same ruling in two tabs, answer in tab 1, then answer and dismiss in tab 2. Tab 2's card must leave with "Answered elsewhere", with no "reply failed" and no new run in Dispatch history.
- **Outside**: the sibling client surfaces listed above (observation.js, scan.js `runDismiss`, flight-companion.js, session.js). Close-out files one follow-up.
- **Outside**: withdrawn rulings (`decision-withdrawn`) are not covered by this guard, as the plan intends. The PR body must say so (check on the PR before merge).
- On merge: close LIN-4142 with a pointer to PR #2279 (plan instruction, post-merge step).

### Verdict
Request Changes. The guard, CAS and client branch are correct and well-witnessed, but an identical-text retry whose own primary stamp landed is refused with 409. That contradicts plan witness 4 / review note 3 and can leave a recorded answer with no run. Next action: `implementation` on this task (fix + witness per the finding), then re-review.

## LIN-4241: revision after Request Changes

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279. Same branch `feat/lin-4241-settled-ruling-guard`, new commit `b7233817` on top of `767bc453`. No new PR.

### Finding → fix

- **Blocking: an identical-text retry after a primary-landed, copy-failed attempt was refused 409 `ruling-settled`.** Fixed in `b7233817` (`routes/workspace-api-issue-write.js`).
  - The route now records, per dedupe key, that this request's own primary stamp landed. The marker is a derived key in `decisionStampDedupe`, so the LIN-3198 reset clears it together with the comment cache.
  - The dedupe-hit retry reads that marker. A primary that reports `alreadySettled` then counts as landed, so the retry stamps the copy and answers 200 `deduped`, with no second comment.
  - Only the dedupe-hit path reads the marker. A fresh write never does.
  - A race loser whose primary never landed for its key is still refused 409. The existing race witness is unchanged and passes.
- **Witness** `LIN-4241 retry witness` in `tests/unit/comment-write-route.test.js`: a stateful store whose copy stamp fails once. Unfixed code: `AssertionError … 409 !== 200`. With the marker disabled, the same red. With the fix restored, green.
- The PR body now names the retry behaviour and the new test counts.

### Evidence

- `npm run test:unit`: 23115 pass, 0 fail.
- `npm run test:hermetic:keyed`: 23115 pass, no non-loopback socket opened.
- CI on `b7233817`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success are all SUCCESS.

### Review items still open before merge

- **Real-Mongo arm for the 8-way concurrent `markDecisionAnswered` witness.** The repo has no Mongo-backed test arm (none under `tests/` or `scripts/`), so this was not run. The PR's earlier real-Mongo check covers only the projection and legacy-CAS points.
- **Two-tab manual repro** on a Home "Waiting on you" card (answer in tab 1, answer and dismiss in tab 2, expecting "Answered elsewhere" and no run). Not performed here. The review still lists it as a pre-merge item.
- **Sibling surfaces** the review asked to file as one follow-up: `public/observation.js` Rulings tab, `public/scan.js` `runDismiss`, `public/flight-companion.js` and `public/session.js`. The PR body lists only the Rulings tab, so the other three still need the follow-up filed.

## Review — LIN-4241

Re-review of PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279 at head `b7233817b642fa113b2c0064f56f172e832dab76` (fix commit on top of `767bc453`; base `main` 950113b1). No commits on `main` since this ticket was created touch the PR's files.

CI: green on b7233817. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success are all SUCCESS; mergeable.

### The previous blocking finding is fixed
`b7233817` adds a per-key marker, `primaryStampKey(key)` in `decisionStampDedupe`, which is cleared by the LIN-3198 reset. The dedupe-hit retry reads it, so a primary that reports `alreadySettled` counts as landed when this key's own earlier attempt stamped it. The diff stays in `routes/workspace-api-issue-write.js` and its test, which is in scope.
- Mutation checks (all reverted):
  - **M-a**, `primaryAlreadyLanded` forced `false`: `LIN-4241 retry witness` goes red (`409 !== 200`).
  - **M-b**, marker never written: the witness goes red.
  - **M-c**, `isRetry &&` gate removed so a fresh write also reads the marker: **all 54 tests in the file stay green.** The gate has no witness (see finding 2).
- The PR body now says withdrawn rulings are excluded ("Withdrawn rulings (`decision-withdrawn`) are **not** settled under this guard…"). That item is discharged.

### Finding 1 (blocks, inside): the same choice answered from a second tab gets 200 `deduped`, so a second run starts
The class is the comment-route settled guard (plan witness 1: "Answer the same loop ruling twice. The second call returns 409 ruling-settled, writes no comment, enqueues no run"). LIN-4142 is folded in here.

The comment dedupe key is `dedupeKey(urlKey, issueId, body, generation, 'human-comment')`. Nothing in it identifies the submitter or the tab. A choice card posts the choice label as its text (`question-cards.js` `opts.prompt`). So two tabs that click the **same option** within the 5-minute TTL send byte-identical bodies and share one key.

The second request hits `commentDedupe`. `decisionStampDedupe.get(key)` is already true, so `settledElsewhere` is false, and the route returns **200 `deduped`**. `ReplyDelivery` treats any 2xx comment write as success and dispatches, so the second tab starts a second run for a settled ruling. That is exactly the double-answer this ticket exists to stop, on the Home "Waiting on you" card it targets.

Reproduced with a temporary probe in `tests/unit/comment-write-route.test.js` (reverted), using `makeSettlingStore` and posting `{ body: 'Option A', decisionLoopId: 'loop-1', decisionId: 'd-1' }` twice. The first returns 201 and the second returns **200 `deduped`** (1 comment, 1 stamp). The result is the same at `767bc453`, so the fix commit did not introduce it. It is a gap in the first-pass implementation that the first review missed.

`b7233817` widens it a little. An identical-text race loser whose winner's copy failed now also reads the winner's marker as its own and gets 200. The existing race witness uses two different texts ("answer A" / "answer B"), so it cannot see any of this.

Why the plan did not settle it: the server cannot tell a genuine retry (the first response was dropped, so the retry must get 200 and the run must start) from a second tab. Both send the same text. The key needs something that identifies the submission.

Fix (implementation, within the plan's places: the comment route and `question-cards.js`):
1. Have the client send a per-submission id, e.g. `answerAttemptId`. `question-cards.js` mints it once per card render and reuses it for that card's retries.
2. The route records the id that landed the primary, as the marker's value instead of `true`. On a dedupe hit for a decision answer, it returns 200 only when the request's `answerAttemptId` matches the recorded one. Otherwise it returns 409 `ruling-settled`, both when every stamp landed and in the copy-failed branch.
3. A request with no `answerAttemptId` keeps today's behaviour, so the unconverted surfaces (`observation.js`, `session.js`, `flight-companion.js`, agents) are unaffected.
4. Add witnesses:
   - Identical text from two different attempt ids, run sequentially, gives 201 then 409, with no further comment or stamp.
   - The same in a barrier race, giving one 201 and one 409.
   - The existing `LIN-4241 retry witness`, with one attempt id across its calls, stays 200.
   - Mutation-check the new witnesses against b7233817; they must go red there.

If the team would rather accept the gap for now (LIN-4242's live refresh narrows the window but does not close it), drop it explicitly with that reason on this ticket. It must not be filed as a separate ticket.

### Finding 2 (minor, inside; settle with finding 1): the `isRetry` gate has no witness
M-c above survives. The gate matters only when two identical-text requests both miss `commentDedupe` and race. Without the gate, the loser would read the winner's marker and get 200. Finding 1's barrier-race witness covers it once it exists.

### Regression check
No commits on `main` since 2026-11-04T22:38Z touch the touched files, and there are no reverts. The fix only adds a derived key in the existing LIN-2208 cache, and the LIN-3198 reset clears it. The prior regression notes (LIN-2208, LIN-3959, LIN-2889, LIN-3009) still hold at this head.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
Finding 1 is the class "a dedupe-hit 200 that stands in for a settled refusal". In this PR's routes, it reaches only the comment route. `dismissSpec` and scan dismiss have no comment dedupe, so their pre-check runs every time. A scan-row identical-text second answer gets the same 200 but has a `record` effect with no run. The same fix covers it. The client sibling surfaces from the last review stay **outside**, unchanged.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (comment-route settled guard / plan witness 1): an identical-text second answer from another tab or submission is refused. **Not met** (finding 1). Settle it before the merge with the fix and witnesses above. Distinguishing precondition: the same `body` and `decisionLoopId` posted twice within the TTL with different `answerAttemptId`s must give 201 then 409, and the same id must give 201 then 200.
- **Inside** (store CAS class): the 8-way concurrent `markDecisionAnswered` was proven only against `tests/fixtures/mock-collection.js`. The implementer confirmed the repo has no Mongo-backed test arm. Settle it **after the deploy**: double-submit one loop ruling from two tabs with **different** answer text (so the comment dedupe is not involved), then check that the item's feedback has exactly one `decision-answer` stamp for that `decision_id` and Dispatch history shows one run.
- **Inside** (client card removal): no E2E drives a real browser through a 409 `ruling-settled` on a Home "Waiting on you" card. Settle it before the merge with a manual repro. Open one ruling in two tabs and answer in tab 1. In tab 2, answer with (a) a different choice and (b) the **same** choice, then dismiss. Each time, tab 2's card must leave with "Answered elsewhere", with no "reply failed" and no new run. Case (b) fails today (finding 1).
- **Outside**: sibling client surfaces `public/observation.js` Rulings tab, `public/scan.js` `runDismiss`, `public/flight-companion.js` and `public/session.js` show generic copy on the 409 (the server behaviour is correct). The PR body lists only observation.js. Close-out files one follow-up, after checking that LIN-4242 does not absorb it.
- **Outside**, discharged: the PR body states withdrawn rulings are not covered.
- On merge (post-merge step): close LIN-4142 with a pointer to PR #2279.

### Verdict
Request Changes. The retry fix is correct and its witness goes red under mutation. But the same choice answered from a second tab is still deduped to a 200, which starts a second run for a settled ruling. That contradicts plan witness 1 on the exact surface this ticket targets. Next action: `implementation` on this task (per-submission id plus witnesses, per finding 1), or an explicit drop with its reason; then re-review.

## LIN-4241: revision after Request Changes (second pass)

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279. Same branch `feat/lin-4241-settled-ruling-guard`, new commit `e14e0d08` on top of `b7233817`. No new PR.

### Finding → fix

- **Finding 1 (blocks): the same choice from a second tab got 200 deduped, so a second run started.** Fixed in `e14e0d08`.
  - `public/question-cards.js` mints one `answerAttemptId` per card and reuses it for that card's retries. `public/common.js` forwards it in the comment body.
  - The settling stamp records which ruling it settled and which submission landed it. A dedupe-hit request for the same ruling with a different submission id is refused `409 ruling-settled` before any stamp. A resend with the same id is still a retry: `200 deduped`, copies stamped.
  - Scan rows follow the same path, so a second answer to a scan row is refused too.
  - Witnesses: second tab after a copy-failed first attempt, after a full landing, and on a scan row; scan-row copy-failed retry; the card's id on the wire.
- **Finding 2 (minor): the `isRetry` gate had no witness.** Added. The race witness now delays the loser's comment write so its stamp runs after the winner's marker is set. It runs both a different-id race and a same-id race, and expects one `201` and one `409`. Removing the gate turns it red.
- **Also fixed while here:** the marker now names its ruling, so a same-text answer to a different ruling is not read as a retry of the first. Witness: "marker is per ruling".
- **Not changed (scoped out by the review):** `observation.js` Rulings tab, `session.js`, `flight-companion.js` and agents still send no `answerAttemptId`. A same-text second answer from them still dedupes to 200. Left for the close-out follow-up. Its PR-body note is updated.

### Evidence

- `npm run test:unit`: 23122 pass, 0 fail. `npm run test:hermetic:keyed`: 23122 pass, no socket escapes.
- Against the unfixed route, five of the new witnesses fail. Mutation checks, each restored: removing the second-submission refusal, the `isRetry` gate, the per-ruling check, and the scan-row honouring each turn at least one witness red.
- CI on `e14e0d08`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success all SUCCESS.

### Still open before merge (not done in this pass)

- **Real-Mongo arm** for the 8-way concurrent `markDecisionAnswered` witness. The repo has no Mongo-backed test arm, so this was not run. Post-deploy check: double-submit one loop ruling from two tabs with different text. Expect one `decision-answer` stamp for that `decision_id` and one run in Dispatch history.
- **Two-tab manual repro** on a Home "Waiting on you" card: answer in tab 1, then in tab 2 answer with a different choice, answer with the same choice, and dismiss. Each tab-2 case should show "Answered elsewhere", no "reply failed", and no new run. The same-choice case is now covered by server and client witnesses, but no browser run has been done.
- **Close-out:** file the one follow-up for the sibling surfaces (`observation.js`, `scan.js` `runDismiss`, `flight-companion.js`, `session.js`) after checking LIN-4242 does not absorb it.

## Review — LIN-4241

Third review of PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2279 at head `e14e0d08283bf59119c25c9ad2c6b9a8c2c57239` (fix commit on top of `b7233817`). `main` is now at `279dcb0a` (LIN-4240). No commit on `main` since this ticket was created (2026-11-04T22:38Z) touches the PR's files. Mergeable.

CI: green on e14e0d08. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan (source) and CI success are all SUCCESS. Locally, the three touched test files pass 96/96 at this head.

### Scope vs plan
`e14e0d08` stays inside the plan's places: the comment route, `question-cards.js`, and the `ReplyDelivery` pass-through in `common.js`, plus tests. It follows the previous review's fix as written:
- The id is minted once per bound card (inside `initQuestionCards`, not per send).
- The marker is now `{ target, attemptId }`.
- A dedupe hit with a different id on the same ruling is refused before any stamp.
- A request with no id keeps the LIN-2208 behaviour.
- The PR body states the withdrawn exclusion and the gap for unconverted surfaces.

The scan-row `primary: true` / `primaryAlreadyLanded` honouring and the per-ruling `target` were not asked for, but both are needed for the same fix to hold on scan rows and across rulings. No overrun.

### Previous findings
- **Finding 1 (second tab, same choice → 200 deduped → second run): fixed.**
- **Finding 2 (`isRetry` gate had no witness): fixed.** If the gate is removed, `LIN-4241 race: … one 201 and one 409` goes red.

### Mutation checks (LIN-2274), each reverted
- **A.** `secondSubmission` forced `false`: 3 red (the second-tab tests: copy-failed, full landing, scan row).
- **B.** Attempt-id comparison forced `true`, so every resend counts as a second submission: the same 3 red.
- **C.** Target check removed from `primaryAlreadyLanded`: `marker is per ruling` red.
- **D.** Scan-row `settledElsewhere && primaryAlreadyLanded` branch removed: `retry witness (scan row + copy failed)` red.
- **E.** Client mints a new id on every `send()`: `answer carries one submission id per card…` red.

The class is "a dedupe-hit 200 that stands in for a settled refusal". On this PR's routes it reaches only the comment route, and it is now closed for every caller that sends `answerAttemptId`. ## Survey 1a (round 3)

I did the third pass (`e14e0d08`, the second-tab fix), so this is mostly that view.

**1. Why was it difficult?** It bound in one branch: the comment route's dedupe-hit path (`routes/workspace-api-issue-write.js`). LIN-2208 deliberately lets an identical-text resend retry a failed stamp, and the dedupe key is text only. "Retry", "race loser" and "second tab picking the same option" all arrive as the same request. Each review round found one more of those cases in the same ten lines. The server could not tell them apart without something from the client. So the fix had to reach into `question-cards.js` and `common.js` for a per-card `answerAttemptId`. Smaller frictions: test cache leakage, and a parity test pinning the card's request to the Rulings tab's.

**2. What I'd have done first.** Draw the state table before any code: fresh write or dedupe hit, primary landed or copy failed or settled elsewhere, same or different submission. Then write one witness per cell. The three passes fixed cells one at a time because nobody had listed them all.

**3. What I'd tidy.** `decisionStampDedupe` now holds two shapes under two keys: `key → true`, and `key:primary → { target, attemptId }`. I'd make that one entry. `common.js` has four identical `postComment` decision literals, and I added a field to each. In the tests, the stateful "copy fails once" store is written inline about five times and wants a helper.

**4. The ticket if the code were how I'd want it.** "A ruling answer carries an idempotency key. The server settles a ruling once, keyed on (ruling, submission): the same submission replays, a different one gets 409." Most of this guard would then be a few lines.

**5. What the plan got wrong.** It put the pre-check after the dedupe-hit branch and treated that branch as a pure retry path. Its witness 1 ("answer twice → 409") never said "with identical text", which is exactly the case the text key collapses. It also assumed "copy already stamped = landed" covered partial attempts. It missed that the primary can be stamped by the request's own earlier attempt.

**6. What it left behind.** The id exists only on the card path. The Rulings tab, `session.js`, `flight-companion.js` and agents don't send it, so one server route now behaves two ways depending on the caller. That is the main thing living in two places. The parity test now exempts one field. The agent-lane dedupe in `routes/proxy.js` didn't learn any of this. What got simpler: one refusal shape (`lib/ruling-settled.js`). Also, after the 5-minute TTL the plain pre-check refuses on its own, so the gap is bounded to that window.

**7. Did the larger scope pay?** In my pass it was mixed. Scan rows cost real work: I had to widen "primary" to cover the task row and add two witnesses. But they share the same branch, so fixing them together was cheaper than a second visit. The expensive part, three review rounds on dedupe interplay, was core scope either way. I'd draw the line at server guard, store CAS and card as one piece, sibling surfaces out. I'd also name the per-submission id in the plan as its own step, rather than letting review discover it.
